# Biscuit the Camping Bulldog — Prime RV Shop — Shop

Page: https://primerv.biscuitthecampingbulldog.com/

A shop for Prime RV (formerly Liquified RV) holding-tank care: toilet and tank treatments, value bundles and kits, wash and exterior care, and sewer hoses and fittings — the same products the operators use in their own fifth wheel. Every order button links to the matching product on primerv.com through the shop's partner link.

Who runs it: Biscuit the Camping Bulldog (Denise & Jeffrey Myers, full-time RVers), affiliate partner of Prime RV. Orders may earn a commission at no extra cost to the buyer.

Good to know: 15% off Prime RV products with the code BISCUIT at checkout.
